summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a lightweight cybersecurity-focused fine-tune of Gemini 3.5 Flash that powers its CodeMender vulnerability-finding agent, initially available only to governments and trusted partners while CodeMender's broader capabilities reach customers via the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.

mechanisms.reason: The lab describes achieving competitive vulnerability-finding performance against much larger models by using a smaller, cheaper model called repeatedly, reducing the compute needed per useful output.
mechanisms.quote: Leveraging the low cost of 3.5 Flash Cyber by configuring CodeMender to call 3.5 Flash Cyber up to five times for a single, final report, the overall agent achieved competitive performance against significantly larger models on CyberGym

mechanisms.reason: An agentic pipeline that invokes the model multiple times per task to scan large codebases increases aggregate token volume per unit of work.
mechanisms.quote: CodeMender invokes 3.5 Flash Cyber multiple times, so agents can analyze vastly more code paths to discover and validate vulnerabilities.

mechanisms.reason: Vulnerability discovery is executed as a multi-call, sub-agent pipeline that aggregates into a single report rather than a single seat-based query.
mechanisms.quote: The sub-agents then produce a single, high-quality report.

practices.reason: A fine-tuned, cost-efficient model specifically for finding, validating and patching vulnerabilities is worth evaluating for security tooling, though it is not yet broadly available.
practices.quote: fine-tuned to find, validate, and patch vulnerabilities quickly and efficiently, making it more effective at these tasks than Gemini’s mainline Flash models

practices.reason: CyberGym is a named, reproducible benchmark for real-world vulnerability discovery that a security engineering team could run against its own agents.
practices.quote: we tested 3.5 Flash Cyber on the CyberGym benchmark, which evaluates AI agents against hundreds of real-world software vulnerabilities

practices.reason: The multi-call, sub-agent-to-single-report pattern for exploring a large search space is a concrete architecture worth evaluating for our own agentic pipelines, though details of the aggregation step are sparse.
practices.quote: CodeMender invokes 3.5 Flash Cyber multiple times, so agents can analyze vastly more code paths to discover and validate vulnerabilities. The sub-agents then produce a single, high-quality report.

practices.reason: CodeMender's capabilities reaching customers through a named enterprise platform is a rollout worth tracking for future integration, though no interface details are given.
practices.quote: we're also bringing CodeMender's foundational capabilities directly to customers with generally available Gemini models through the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
